hypothesis: The r14 current-method comparison evaluated the r5b parent without the hard-causality operation used by r5b training and the PI-DeepONet baseline, inflating the reported r5b error.
mechanism: The saved-time parent config masks predictions before the source causal onset at t0 minus one source cycle, while the CPADC parent prediction helper currently returns the raw dense output.
primary_metric: exact32 relative L2 on the archived r14 PI time indices
failure_signal: The raw result does not reproduce r14 within 1e-5, or hard causality retains more than half of the raw exact32 relative error.
rollback: No checkpoint or model state is modified; preserve r14 and all r5b and CPADC checkpoints.
